description: Delegate a web/documentation lookup to the Antigravity CLI (Gemini with web access): library docs, API references, error messages, current versions, external knowledge. USE THIS when you need information you don't have or that may be newer than your training data.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory / project root. Defaults to the server's cwd.

model.description: Override the model: a name or id from `agy models`, or a `*` version pattern such as "Gemini * Pro (High)". Normally omit — the tool routes automatically.

query.description: What to look up on the web.

name: web_lookup
